# Version 4.151.0 (Unreleased)
> **Graphite GPU backend and new packages**

## Highlights

SkiaSharp 4.151.0 (unreleased) adds the Graphite GPU backend, async pixel reads, and a dedicated Vulkan/Silk.NET package. The new Graphite bindings expose Vulkan, Metal, and Dawn GPU backends under the next-generation Skia renderer. An async `RequestReadPixels` API lands on SKImage and SKSurface, a new `SkiaSharp.Vulkan.Silk.NET` integration package ships, FreeType brings fonts to Nano Server, and several performance and memory fixes round out the release.

## Breaking Changes

*None in this preview line.*

## Engine

- **Upstream Skia m151 stability fixes** — Additional chrome/m151 upstream syncs harden the engine and keep the submodule current with the latest stability fixes. ([#4537](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4537), [#4538](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4538), [#4568](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4568))

## API Surface

- **Graphite GPU backend bindings for Vulkan, Metal, and Dawn** — The new next-generation Skia Graphite renderer is now bound in SkiaSharp, exposing Vulkan, Metal, and Dawn backends alongside the existing Ganesh path. — ❤️ [@ramezgerges](https://github.com/ramezgerges) ([#3968](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3968))
- **Async RequestReadPixels on SKImage and SKSurface** — A new backend-neutral `RequestReadPixels` API lets callers schedule an asynchronous pixel readback without blocking the rendering thread. ([#4545](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4545))
- **SkiaSharp.Vulkan.Silk.NET integration package** — A new NuGet package wires SkiaSharp's Vulkan backend directly to the Silk.NET Vulkan bindings, simplifying setup for Silk.NET-based applications. ([#4527](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4527))
- **FreeType font support on Nano Server** — Nano Server (which lacks the GDI font stack) now ships FreeType-backed font management, unblocking SkiaSharp text rendering in containerized Windows workloads. — ❤️ [@jeffska](https://github.com/jeffska) ([#4280](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4280))
- **Deterministic binding generation across platforms** — The binding generator now produces identical output regardless of the host OS, so checked-in generated files no longer drift between Windows and Linux CI agents. ([#4612](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4612))

## Bug Fixes

- **CoTaskMem pixel-buffer leak in SKImage.Create raster failure path** — When the raster image creation path failed after allocating a CoTaskMem pixel buffer, the buffer was leaked. The failure path now correctly frees the allocation. ([#4455](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4455))

## Lifecycle & Internals

- **SKData.SaveTo avoids double buffer copy** — The `SaveTo` path now writes directly to the output stream without an intermediate buffer copy, halving allocations for large data exports. ([#4550](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4550))
- **String allocation eliminated in GetEncodedText null-terminated path** — The null-terminated fast path in `GetEncodedText` now reuses a buffer instead of allocating an intermediate string on every call. ([#4498](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4498))
- **SKRuntimeEffectUniforms lookup map pre-sized** — The uniform-name lookup map is pre-sized to the known uniform count at construction, eliminating resizes during effect setup. ([#4512](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4512))
- **Windows MSVC environment initialized once per native build** — The MSVC toolchain environment is now set up once rather than once per target, cutting Windows native build times significantly. — ❤️ [@mmitche](https://github.com/mmitche) ([#4570](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4570))

## Platform

- **Containerized test targets: Azure Linux, Alpine/musl, Nano Server** — Three new containerized CI test legs verify SkiaSharp on Azure Linux, Alpine (musl libc), and Nano Server, expanding the supported platform matrix. ([#4515](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4515))
- **Solutions converted to .slnx format** — All .sln solution files are converted to the lighter .slnx format, reducing churn and improving IDE load times. ([#4528](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4528))
